usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all roles defined in Proxmox Datacenter Manager, including both built-in system roles and any custom roles. Available to every authenticated user and API token — no special privilege required. Useful before assigning permissions to a user or token, so you can confirm the exact roleid and its associated privilege set.

examples.summary: List all available roles to find the right role before assigning permissions

tips: The response includes a 'privs' array on each role — inspect it to verify a role grants the exact privileges needed before assigning it.
Built-in system roles (e.g. Administrator, NoAccess, PVEAdmin) are included alongside any custom roles; filter by roleid prefix if you only want one category.
This endpoint is safe to call with a least-privilege API token since it requires no elevated permissions.
